result.question: What does the man of God say to the king?

readings.answer: He refuses to go with him or eat or drink there, even for half his possessions.
readings.support: If you were to give me half your possessions, I still would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water in this place.

readings.answer: He was commanded by the LORD not to eat, drink, or return by the same way.
readings.support: For this is what I was commanded by the word of the LORD: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water or return by the way you came.’

assessments.reason: It explicitly includes “I still would not go with you,” which is a direct paraphrase of “I will not go with you,” and is supported by verse 13:8.
He also says he was commanded not to eat, drink, or return the same way (v.9); this is something he says to the king, though it is not the keyed refusal phrase.
